request: Pull the UK Environment Agency (Defra) real-time flood-monitoring 'measures' catalogue from environment.data.gov.uk — one row per (station x parameter x qualifier), ~5.6k rows nationwide across England. Each measure carries a nested latestReading with the most recent observed value + timestamp. We flatten latestReading.value / latestReading.dateTime via dotted_path and enrich with level_band (numeric_bin on reading value: <0 dry / 0-0.5 low / 0.5-1.5 normal / 1.5-3 elevated / 3+ high), parameter_class (map_values parameter: level=water_level, flow=river_flow, wind=wind, temperature=temperature, rainfall=rainfall, others=other), reading_freshness_days (days_since latestReading.dateTime), and stage_qualifier_group (map_values qualifier: Stage/Downstream Stage/Upstream Stage=stage, Tidal Level=tidal, Groundwater=groundwater, Rainfall=rainfall). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 33 - UK Environment Agency Flood Monitoring' on Tableau Server for Defra / EA / local resilience forum analysts. Keyless, Open Government Licence.

sources.name: UK EA Flood Monitoring Measures
sources.description: environment.data.gov.uk /flood-monitoring/id/measures — full catalogue of all measurement channels from ~4200 active EA telemetry stations across England, one row per (station x parameter x qualifier). Each row includes station reference, label (usually 'RIVER X AT Y'), parameter (level/flow/rainfall/wind/temperature), qualifier (Stage/Downstream Stage/Tidal Level/etc.), period (seconds between observations), unit, and the nested latestReading (value + ISO dateTime). Keyless, OGL v3.

args.name: EA Flood Measures Trend
args.features_description: Row-level UK Environment Agency flood-monitoring measures — one row per (station x parameter x qualifier). Fields: notation (measure id, unique), stationReference (EA station code), label (RIVER X AT Y — telemetry site), parameter (level/flow/rainfall/wind/temperature), parameter_class (water_level/river_flow/rainfall/wind/temperature/other), parameterName (verbose), qualifier (Stage/Downstream Stage/Tidal Level/Groundwater/etc.), stage_qualifier_group (stage/tidal/groundwater/rainfall/flow/etc.), unitName (mASD/m3s-1/mm/etc.), valueType (instantaneous/mean), period (seconds), latest_value (last observation, decimal), latest_dateTime (ISO 8601 UTC), latest_date (YYYY-MM-DD), level_band (dry/low/normal/elevated/high), reading_freshness_days (days since last observation).
args.stats_description: Long-form EA flood-monitoring statistics (dimension x value x year x month) over parameter_class, stage_qualifier_group, level_band. Rolling 30-day counts, z-anomalies vs baseline. Use to spot regional/parameter-level shifts in level distribution or telemetry-station reporting gaps.

outputs.name: UK EA Flood Measures Detail
outputs.description: Row-level UK Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring measures — one row per (station x parameter x qualifier), ~5.6k rows across all EA telemetry stations in England. Fields: notation (measure id, unique), stationReference (EA station code), label (RIVER X AT Y), parameter (level/flow/rainfall/wind/temperature), parameter_class (water_level/river_flow/rainfall/wind/temperature/other), parameterName, qualifier (Stage/Downstream Stage/Tidal Level/etc.), stage_qualifier_group (stage/tidal/groundwater/rainfall/flow/etc.), unitName, valueType, period, latest_value (last observation), latest_dateTime (ISO 8601), latest_date, level_band (dry/low/normal/elevated/high on water-level), reading_freshness_days. Source: environment.data.gov.uk/flood-monitoring, OGL v3. Refresh: hourly.

outputs.name: UK EA Flood Measures Stats
outputs.description: Long-form UK EA flood-monitoring measure statistics (dimension x value x year x month) over parameter_class, stage_qualifier_group, level_band. Rolling 30-day counts, z-anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month).
